You are an entertainer, and they are your hopeless fans. Combat pass: damaging and support modes now hit. Menus, skill copying, disguises, and the missing Fantasy World are still absent.
mysticism_ultimates.blocker.ame_no_uzume: Needs the idol-mode client packet and the spotlight effect.
mysticism_ultimates.skill.antaeus.descri: Gravity and the forces of attraction bend to your every whim. Some could even say you are limitless. Combat pass: damaging and support modes now hit. Menus, skill copying, disguises, and the missing Fantasy World are still absent.
mysticism_ultimates.blocker.antaeus: Needs the limitless barrier entity, attraction projectiles, and its menu.
mysticism_ultimates.skill.antithesis.des: You have become vividly aware of the things that make up this world. But can you use it in the right way? Combat pass: damaging and support modes now hit. Menus, skill copying, disguises, and the missing Fantasy World are still absent.
mysticism_ultimates.blocker.antithesis: Inverse, the predecessor unique, is not in Mysticism 2.2.1. Redirect also needs the old spatial exchange.
mysticism_ultimates.skill.asmodeus.descr: Play the forces of life and death as if life really were that fickle. Revive, tempt and defy fate as you focus everything into your blade. Combat pass: damaging and support modes now hit. Menus, skill copying, disguises, and the missing Fantasy World are still absent.
mysticism_ultimates.blocker.asmodeus: The 1.1.1 evolution map has no predecessor. Revive and drain need subordinate packets.
mysticism_ultimates.skill.beelzebub.desc: The guardian, the protector, the gourmet. Stomach stores 256 slots of 1337. Hold Predation to eat the cone in front of you into that stomach and take the skills in that cone, including resistances and uniques. Ultimates stay. Sneak-press cycles None, Blocks, Fluids, and All, and scroll changes the range. Provide and Receive open a skill menu and can move resistances as well as other skills. Ultimates stay out. Provide teaches the chosen skill to the subordinate you are looking at, and Receive takes the chosen skill from them. Isolation clears harmful effects, severance, and one dissolving item. Hold Corrosion to eat nearby existence. Press Substitution to take hits for your subordinates. Toggle the skill for an iron wall.
mysticism_ultimates.blocker.beelzebub: Fox Ablaze Ultimate already has its own Beelzebub. This one is the addon skill.
mysticism_ultimates.skill.beelzebub.isol: Harmful effects and severance were cleared.
mysticism_ultimates.skill.beelzebub.subs: Substitution armed. Subordinate hits come to you.

mysticism_ultimates.skill.bushyasta.desc: Use the power of stagnation to prevent all change to yourself or others, to empower your attacks, or even stop the hearts of your enemies. Combat pass: damaging and support modes now hit. Menus, skill copying, disguises, and the missing Fantasy World are still absent.
mysticism_ultimates.blocker.bushyasta: Needs InactionHandler and the multilayer barrier.
mysticism_ultimates.skill.dionysus.descr: The true essence of the destroyer. Decimate and remove all threats from existence and delete chunks with your indomitable will. Combat pass: damaging and support modes now hit. Menus, skill copying, disguises, and the missing Fantasy World are still absent.
mysticism_ultimates.blocker.dionysus: Needs dimension hopping and Turn Null chunk removal.
mysticism_ultimates.skill.galileo.descri: The true-sight of one who has mastered their instincts, able to notice all at a moment's glance. Petrify your enemies and turn them into dust. mysticism_ultimates.skill.viciel.descrip: The ultimate above Hidden Ruler. True Copy opens a skill menu for the creature you are looking at, teaches you the chosen skill, and keeps it in the collection. Sneak-press lists that collection. Toggle the skill to conceal yourself.

mysticism_ultimates.skill.vainglory.desc: You, the one who conquers this sacred land, in control over both Shadow and Light. Requires mastered Plunderer and mastered Darkness Manipulation. mysticism_ultimates.skill.otherworldly.d: Transcending the conventional boundaries of this realm. Passive toggle bestows Luck V and Hero of the Village V as is. Active cast Shared Secrets strips any entity of boss, mind control, and plunder immunities, rendering it completely vulnerable, nameable, and tamable (requires having visited the Overworld, Nether, End, Hell, and Labyrinth; 24m cooldown, 100 mastery; 10s cooldown on miss). Active cast Closed Loop permanently fixes a random temporary skill into your repertoire (requires mastery, 24m cooldown). Both abilities share their cooldown.
